data.long_meaning: Jemimah means ‘graceful little dove’ in Hebrew. In the Bible, Jemimah was a beautiful virgin from Jerusalem, who was one of King Solomon’s 700 wives. In English, the name Jemimah is a feminine name, which means 'to sleep, to rest, a dream.'
